3131-how-spring-came-in-new-england.title: How Spring Came In New England
3131-how-spring-came-in-new-england.creator: Charles Dudley Warner
3131-how-spring-came-in-new-england.description: A book by Charles Dudley Warner. eason the Irish emigrate--they desire two crops the same year. The Gulf Stream gets shunted off from New England by the formation of the coast below: besides, it is too shallow to be of any service. Icebergs float down against its surface-current, and fill all the New-England air with the chill of death till June: after that the fogs drift down from Newfoundland.

arxiv-2105-07398.title: On the Secrecy Rate of Downlink NOMA in Underlay Spectrum Sharing with Imperfect CSI
arxiv-2105-07398.creator: Vaibhav Kumar 1 , Mark F. Flanagan 1 , Daniel Benevides da Costa 2 , and Le-Nam Tran 1
arxiv-2105-07398.description: Abstract In this paper, we present the ergodic sum secrecy rate (ESSR) analysis of an underlay spectrum sharing non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) system. We consider the scenario where the power transmitted by the secondary transmitter (ST) is constrained by the peak tolerable interference at multiple primary receivers (PRs) as well as the maximum transmit power of the ST.

arxiv-2112-05756.title: Enhancing Multi-Scale Implicit Learning in Image Super-Resolution with Integrated Positional Encoding
arxiv-2112-05756.creator: Ying-Tian Liu Yuan-Chen Guo Song-Hai Zhang
arxiv-2112-05756.description: Abstract Is the center position fully capable of representing a pixel? There is nothing wrong to represent pixels with their centers in a discrete image representation, but it makes more sense to consider each pixel as the aggregation of signals from a local area in an image super-resolution (SR) context.

arxiv-2208-10363.title: Looking for the Signals of the Missing Baryons in the Extragalactic Background Light
arxiv-2208-10363.creator: Wei Zhu, Rong Wang
arxiv-2208-10363.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Wei Zhu, Rong Wang. The missing baryons in the universe are assumed to be hidden in the whole space as a warm-hot intergalactic medium (WHIM). Finding them is one of the important subjects in modern cosmology. In this paper, we point out that the very high energy electron/positron rays may light up the WHIM due to the anomalous bremsstrahlung according to an improved Bethe-Heitler formula. The resulting excess of the extragalactic background light (EBL) can be observed by the direct measurement method.

arxiv-2405-19921.title: MCDS-VSS: Moving Camera Dynamic Scene Video Semantic Segmentation by Filtering with Self-Supervised Geometry and Motion
arxiv-2405-19921.creator: Angel Villar-Corrales, Moritz Austermann, Sven Behnke
arxiv-2405-19921.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Angel Villar-Corrales, Moritz Austermann, Sven Behnke. Autonomous systems, such as self-driving cars, rely on reliable semantic environment perception for decision making. Despite great advances in video semantic segmentation, existing approaches ignore important inductive biases and lack structured and interpretable internal representations. In this work, we propose MCDS-VSS , a structured filter model that learns in a self-supervised manner to estimate scene geometry and ego-motion of the camera, while also estimating the motion of external objects.

arxiv-2509-23280.title: Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning for Asset–Liability Management
arxiv-2509-23280.creator: Yilie Huang
arxiv-2509-23280.description: Abstract . This paper proposes a novel approach for Asset–Liability Management (ALM) by employing continuous-time Reinforcement Learning (RL) with a linear-quadratic (LQ) formulation that incorporates both interim and terminal objectives. We develop a model-free, policy gradient-based soft actor-critic algorithm tailored to ALM for dynamically synchronizing assets and liabilities.

pmc-11474670.title: Hirschsprung-associated enterocolitis: a comprehensive review
pmc-11474670.creator: Ioannis A Ziogas, Korah P Kuruvilla, Ming Fu, Ankush Gosain
pmc-11474670.description: Hirschsprung-associated enterocolitis (HAEC) is an important cause of morbidity and the leading cause of mortality in patients with Hirschsprung disease. The pathophysiology of disease includes dysmotility of the enteric nervous system, dysbiosis of the microbiota, failure of the intestinal barrier, and impaired immunity. Common manifestations include fever, abdominal distension, lethargy, vomiting, and diarrhea.

pmc-11537401.title: Optimizing plastic film mulch to improve the yield and water use efficiency of dryland maize in the Loess Plateau, China
pmc-11537401.creator: Rui Zhang, Hongjuan Zhang, Yunpeng Xing, Lian Xue, Debarati Bhaduri, Debarati Bhaduri, Debarati Bhaduri, Debarati Bhaduri
pmc-11537401.description: Knowledge on the variation of yield and water use efficiency under different mulching methods is important for guiding rained maize production in the Loess Plateau area. In this study, eight different plastic film mulching methods was established to analyze the maize growth, soil water content and soil temperature changes of dryland maize, and increase yield and water use efficiency (WUE).

pmc-12639997.title: Evidence of secondary anopheline vectors in sustaining malaria transmission in Kokrajhar District, Assam, Northeastern India
pmc-12639997.creator: Kuldeep Singh, Ajeet Mohanty, Waseem Akram Malla, Ritesh Ranjha, Jugal Gam, Rahim Ali, Praveen Kumar Bharti, Anup R. Anvikar, Himmat Singh
pmc-12639997.description: BackgroundIn the northeastern region of India, perennial malaria transmission persists in certain hotspots in areas geographically adjacent to the international borders with Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar, where both Plasmodium vivax and Plasmodium falciparum coexist, particularly in remote, forested, and inaccessible areas.

pmc-12968244.title: Network toxicology reveals key genes of amiodarone induced pulmonary fibrosis: based on machine learning and SHAP analysis
pmc-12968244.creator: Xiaoyan Yan, Ying Liu, Rui Fan
pmc-12968244.description: BackgroundAmiodarone (AMD), a highly effective Class III antiarrhythmic drug, has its clinical utility limited by the risk of inducing a serious adverse effect, amiodarone-induced pulmonary fibrosis (AIPF). The pathogenesis of AIPF remains poorly elucidated, particularly the hub driver genes, which hinders early diagnosis and targeted intervention.

pmc-12997541.title: Effects of GPR110 expression on neurobehavioral outcomes in mice
pmc-12997541.creator: Mariam Melkumyan, Bill X. Huang, Joel Toro, Andrew Kesner, Hee-Yong Kim
pmc-12997541.description: IntroductionThe adhesion G Protein-Coupled Receptor 110 (GPR110) is highly expressed in brain during development. Although its level is broadly reduced in adulthood, GPR110 expression notably persists in the hippocampus, yet its role in adult neurobehavioral function remains incompletely defined. In this study, we investigated whether altering GPR110 levels affects behavior and associated molecular pathways in adult mice.

pmc-13131311.title: Parent/caregiver needs during pediatric genome‐wide sequencing: A scoping literature review
pmc-13131311.creator: Priyanka Murali, Joon‐Ho Yu
pmc-13131311.description: The integration of genome‐wide sequencing (GWS) including whole‐exome and whole‐genome sequencing, has transformed pediatric diagnostics, yet the needs of parents and caregivers during this process remain insufficiently explored. This scoping review aims to synthesize current knowledge on parental and caregiver needs across the GWS process in pediatric settings to inform better clinical practices and support systems.

pmc-13303510.title: Obstetric Outcomes Among Underage Mothers: Age-Stratified Analysis from a Romanian Hospital-Based Cohort
pmc-13303510.creator: Florin Mihai Sandor, Izabella Petre, Ion Petre, Florina Buleu, Cris Virgiliu Precup, Roxana Furau, Tiberiu Buleu, Maria Ioana Ardelean, Adrian Loichita, Cristian George Furau
pmc-13303510.description: Background and Objectives: Adolescent pregnancy is traditionally associated with increased obstetric risk, particularly among very young adolescents. Romania continues to report one of the highest adolescent birth rates in the European Union, yet age-stratified clinical data on obstetric outcomes among minors remain limited.

pmc-13399966.title: Failures and complications associated with resorbable and non-resorbable membranes in guided bone regeneration: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13399966.creator: Daniela Sánchez Cousiño, Sonia Egido-Moreno, Beatriz González Navarro, Holmes Ortega Mejía, Andrés Blanco-Carrión, José López-López
pmc-13399966.description: BackgroundPatients treated with guided bone regeneration (GBR) may be treated using resorbable or non- resorbable membranes, which differ in their efficacy, failures and complication profiles. The objective is to evaluate the efficacy and failures and complications of resorbable membranes versus non-resorbable membranes in patients undergoing guided bone regeneration (GBR). A search was conducted until July 31, 2025.

pmc-13512983.title: Preoperative Thrombocytopenia Increases In-Hospital Burden but Not Postoperative Adverse Events After Total Knee Arthroplasty
pmc-13512983.creator: Jisu Park, Moon Jong Chang, Minji Han, Jung-Wee Park, Tae Woo Kim, Young-Kyun Lee, Chong Bum Chang, Seung-Baik Kang
pmc-13512983.description: Background/Objectives: Thrombocytopenia increases bleeding tendency and may complicate perioperative management in total knee arthroplasty (TKA), yet data on both in-hospital burden and post-discharge adverse events are limited. This study evaluated the association between preoperative platelet count and outcomes after primary TKA. Methods: In total, 3474 primary TKAs performed for osteoarthritis at a single institution (2008–2023) were retrospectively reviewed.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
